title: Fig and the Pod
checkpoint: Reception Spring 2, week 1 — Learning — Phase 3: new sounds oa, oo, oo (book)

pages.illustration: Fig the green caterpillar standing at the edge of a round garden pool.
Fig the caterpillar looking across the pool towards a big oak tree on the far side.
Fig the caterpillar standing alone at the pool edge with no boat in sight, looking thoughtful.
Fig the caterpillar finding a large curled brown seed pod lying on the ground.
Fig the caterpillar climbing onto the brown seed pod at the water's edge.

pages.text: The pod can bob on the pool.
pages.illustration: The brown seed pod floating and bobbing gently on the pool, Fig balanced on top.
Fig the caterpillar stepping off the pod onto a root of the big oak tree on the far side.

pages.text: Fig had fun on the pool.
pages.illustration: Fig the caterpillar sitting happily under the oak tree, the brown pod floating empty on the pool behind him.
